title: 黑部水壩
summary: 由黑部峽谷的拱壩背景出發，把融雪集水、岩盤承載、混凝土溫度、輸水損失與下游流量變化連成同一個守恆問題。學員比較靜水、穩流及瞬變三種時間尺度，辨識簡化模型所能回答的問題。所有參數為分開標明的假想教材，不能當成實際設備設定。
summaryEn: Starting from the Kurobe mountain setting, this course connects snowmelt collection, rock support, concrete temperature, conduit losses and downstream flow changes through conservation and compatibility. Learners distinguish static, steady and transient time scales and identify what each reduced model can actually answer. Every numerical parameter is separately identified as hypothetical teaching data rather than an equipment setting.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想融雪流入為每秒二十立方公尺、放流每秒十二立方公尺，六小時內增加十七萬二千八百立方公尺蓄量；這只是水量帳，尚未求出水位。另一假想拱圈以壓力零點八兆帕、半徑一百二十公尺、厚度十公尺求得平均膜壓應力九點六兆帕，不能取代三維壩體分析。把厚度增加百分之二十至十二公尺，應力降至八兆帕；比較結果時仍需考慮岩盤變形與溫度拘束。 核驗：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed snowmelt inflow of 20 m3/s and release of 12 m3/s, six hours adds 172800 m3 of storage; a storage curve is still needed to infer water level. A separate ideal arch strip with pressure 0.8 MPa, radius 120 m and thickness 10 m has mean membrane compression of 9.6 MPa. Increasing thickness by twenty percent to 12 m gives 8 MPa. This sensitivity does not replace three dimensional dam analysis, because foundation movement, bending and thermal restraint remain outside the strip model. Verification: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」與「理想拱圈膜壓應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Snowmelt pulses and storage" and "Ideal arch membrane compression": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snowmelt pulses and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。黑部背景的水量帳必須將庫區當作控制體，分別列出入流、放流與時段，蓄量增加後還需面積高程曲線才能換成水位。 融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. A reservoir control volume separates inflow, release and duration; storage change still needs an area-elevation relationship before it becomes a level change. Snow water equivalent and temporary soil storage also control melt runoff. Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Snowmelt pulses and storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Snowmelt pulses and storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Snowmelt pulses and storage" is correct?
options: 蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升
高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snowmelt pulses and storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。適用邊界：假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Applicable boundary: Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snowmelt pulses and storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將入流峰值改成前兩小時三十、後四小時十五立方公尺每秒，分段求蓄量並與平均法比較，說明兩者何時相同、何時因出口變化而不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Replace constant inflow with thirty cubic metres per second for two hours and fifteen for four hours. Integrate segments and explain when averaging preserves volume and when a varying outlet invalidates the comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snowmelt pulses and storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Even an apparently correct daily volume can conceal the short-term level maximum that matters to storage checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Even an apparently correct daily volume can conceal the short-term level maximum that matters to storage checks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「理想拱圈膜壓應力」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal arch membrane compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。把一條水平窄帶理想化為等厚圓環，只保留膜作用，可從局部力平衡看見半徑與厚度如何改變平均壓應力；實際雙曲率壩仍有懸臂及彎曲。 薄膜模型的壓力乘半徑是每單位高度的環向內力，再除厚度才成為平均應力；這兩個量的單位與用途應分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想拱圈膜壓應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. An ideal constant-thickness circular strip retains membrane action and reveals radius and thickness sensitivity, while the real double-curvature body also carries cantilever and bending effects. Pressure times radius is circumferential force per unit height; division by thickness converts it to mean stress. Distinguishing force resultant from stress makes the approximation and its units explicit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal arch membrane compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ideal arch membrane compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ideal arch membrane compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Uniform normal pressure on a continuous ideal arch strip; joints, foundation compliance and three-dimensional bending are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想拱圈膜壓應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal arch membrane compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。再改變厚度與曲率而保持水壓不變，確認所得應力趨勢合理，並列出必須由三維模型補回的支承條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium. Change thickness and radius separately at fixed pressure, check the trends and identify support conditions that must return in a three-dimensional model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持水壓與半徑不變，將厚度增加到十二公尺後重算，畫出厚度與應力的反比曲線，並說明為何材料用量與整體變形不會只由此曲線決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase thickness to twelve metres at fixed pressure and radius, recalculate and plot the inverse relationship. Explain why this curve alone cannot determine material quantity, foundation response or the complete deformation field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想拱圈膜壓應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ideal arch membrane compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A low average cannot establish that local tensile cracking is absent. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄膜模型的壓力乘半徑是每單位高度的環向內力，再除厚度才成為平均應力；這兩個量的單位與用途應分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguishing force resultant from stress makes the approximation and its units explicit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。
knowledge.textEn: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A low average cannot establish that local tensile cracking is absent.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩盤順應與推力位移」與「混凝土受拘束溫降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abutment compliance under thrust" and "Restrained concrete cooling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩盤順應與推力位移」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment compliance under thrust” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。以一個等效彈簧表示局部岩盤，可把推力與位移連起來，但剛度應包含受力範圍，不能只拿完整岩芯彈性模數直接代入。 同一模數配上不同受力面積或岩盤有效深度，會形成不同支承剛度，因而需要先說明彈簧代表的幾何尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩盤順應與推力位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. A local equivalent spring relates force to displacement, but its stiffness includes geometry and cannot simply be replaced by the elastic modulus of an intact core sample. The same modulus combined with different loaded areas or effective rock depths produces different support stiffnesses. The equivalent spring therefore needs a declared geometric scale before its displacement has physical meaning. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment compliance under thrust” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長引水管的沿程損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Friction in a long conduit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。選取穩定流量時段擬合摩擦因子，再檢查不同流量是否維持合理趨勢，避免把閥件損失全塞入沿程係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge. Fit the friction factor during steady periods and examine its trend across flows rather than absorbing every valve loss into distributed friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持管徑與粗糙度不變，把速度提高百分之二十，重算水頭損失及增加比例，再列出摩擦因子可能隨雷諾數改變而使簡化比較失準的情況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise velocity by twenty percent at fixed diameter and roughness, recalculate head loss and its percentage increase, then identify circumstances where a changing Reynolds number alters the friction factor and weakens the simple comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Friction in a long conduit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Ignoring the velocity-squared term because gross head is large understates added losses at higher flow and miscalculates the net head available to equipment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量線沿流向下降，而壓力線還受高程和速度影響；把兩者分開可避免看到局部低壓便誤判全部水頭耗失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separating them prevents local low pressure from being mistaken for total head dissipation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High head energy conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。黑部案例應先把水路損失從毛水頭扣掉，再談電功率，否則同一耗能會被遺漏或重複扣除。 控制體邊界必須說明是否包含發電機、變壓器與輔機用電，否則兩個看似相同效率可能其實分母分子範圍不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高水頭水能轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. In a high-head case, waterway losses must be separated from gross head before applying an efficiency boundary that clearly identifies which equipment is included. The conversion boundary must identify whether generator, transformer and auxiliary consumption are included. Otherwise two apparently comparable efficiencies can refer to different energy inputs and different reported electrical outputs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High head energy conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。焦科夫斯基關係給出理想快速變化的壓力尺度，與穩流摩擦屬不同物理過程，必須先比較變化時間與波的往返時間。 波速由水與管壁的合成可壓縮性決定，並非水流平均速度；壓力訊息能快速往返，而水體本身位移相對較小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速流速變化與水錘」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly. The Joukowsky relation gives an ideal rapid-change pressure scale, which differs from steady friction and requires comparison of change duration with the wave round-trip time. Wave speed reflects the combined compressibility of water and wall, not mean flow velocity. A pressure signal can travel rapidly back and forth while the water itself moves a comparatively short distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。適用邊界：線性係數是假想校準值，變量範圍限於訓練資料，未計時間延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3。適用邊界：半小時矩形入流脈衝、出口固定且無溢流，未指定實際下游運用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3. Applicable boundary: A thirty-minute rectangular inflow pulse with fixed outlet and no overflow, without specifying real downstream operation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Downstream buffer storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。加入可用庫容上限時，要同時保留初始蓄量，不可從零開始假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them. Check whether subsequent flow differences restore the initial state, retaining initial storage explicitly when comparing against an available-volume limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設第二個相同脈衝在一小時後到達，安排中間假想出流大於入流的時段，計算恢復所需時間並說明若恢復不足會如何累積庫水。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place a second identical pulse one hour later and specify an intervening period with outlet greater than inlet. Calculate recovery time and show how incomplete recovery accumulates water over repeated cycles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：緩衝池連續接收多次脈衝卻沒有恢復時段，會逐步累積水量；只驗證一次脈衝容積而忽略重複週期，可能錯誤宣稱固定容積永遠足夠。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
